rationale:
Issue #345 reports that configured parsingOptions ([.relaxed, .fillRequiredFieldIfKeyNotFound, .fillRequiredFieldIfValueNotFound]) had no effect on the async chats path, producing DecodingError.keyNotFound. The minimized production patch is a single added line in Sources/OpenAI/Private/Client/AsyncClient.swift that sets decoder.userInfo[.parsingOptions] = configuration.parsingOptions immediately before decoder.decode, i.e. it propagates an already-existing configuration value into the already-existing CodingUserInfoKey the response decoders consult. That is exactly the omission the issue describes; no refactor, formatting, feature, docs, config, or test change is present (one file, one hunk, one addition, retained_hunk_count=1, removed_hunk_count=0, post_minimization_validation PASS). The curator trigger exercises the same public path (OpenAI.chats via the pre-existing URLSessionMock and MockStreamingSessionFactory) with parsingOptions: .relaxed and a chat completion payload omitting a required key, asserting the relaxed default rather than any API added by the fix. All symbols it touches (Configuration.parsingOptions, .relaxed, the mocks) predate the commit, and strict evidence confirms build.both_versions passed, so the failure on the buggy revision is a genuine decoding assertion/error failure and not a fix-only-API compile error. Strict gates pass on both the original and post-minimization runs: trigger.buggy_differential reproduced testAsyncChatsHonorsRelaxedParsing, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (3 outcome groups, 3 repetitions, 32-run matrix complete), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green with no failed checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and macpaw/openai#345 is the sole allowed verified issue key, so no duplicate root cause exists.

Issue #345 reports that configured parsingOptions ([.relaxed, .fillRequiredFieldIfKeyNotFound, ...]) have no effect on the async chats path, producing DecodingError.keyNotFound on a missing key. The minimized production patch is a single one-line addition in Sources/OpenAI/Private/Client/AsyncClient.swift that sets decoder.userInfo[.parsingOptions] = configuration.parsingOptions immediately before decoder.decode, which is exactly the missing propagation that made the pre-existing parsing options inert on this path. PR #346 ('Add missing parsingOptions to decoder', 'To fix #345') traces to the issue via fix_commit_to_merged_pr_to_issue, and commit_stats confirms one production file, one hunk, zero test/other files, so there is no refactor, formatting, feature, docs, or config change. The curator trigger constructs the public OpenAI client with parsingOptions: .relaxed over the pre-existing URLSessionMock and MockStreamingSessionFactory, feeds a chat completion payload missing the required id key, and asserts relaxed fill-in behavior (result.id == "") plus preserved fields. Both the client API and the parsing options contract predate the fix, and strict evidence records build.both_versions PASS, so the same trigger source compiles and runs on buggy and fixed revisions; the failure on the buggy revision is a genuine decoding assertion/error difference, not an unavailable-symbol compile error. Strict original and post-minimization gates both pass with a unique selector, deterministic outcomes over 3 repetitions, buggy differential limited to the declared trigger, and fixed full suite all green. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so macpaw/openai#345 is not a duplicate of any active registry entry.
